data.name: The Legend of Loch Ness
data.detailed_description:
Investigate the World's Most Famous Mystery

Legend of Loch Ness is a first-person open-world mystery exploration and investigation game set on the legendary waters of Loch Ness and the Scottish Highlands.

Explore a vast recreation of Loch Ness as you track sightings, gather evidence, photograph unexplained phenomena, deploy scientific equipment, and uncover secrets hidden beneath the loch's dark waters. Travel freely across the loch by boat, motorcycle, and on foot while investigating one of the world's most enduring mysteries.

But discovering the truth is only one option.

Develop photographs in your darkroom, analyse evidence, build your reputation as an investigator, or exploit the world's fascination with Nessie through carefully crafted hoaxes. Create convincing evidence, attract media attention, and turn myth into profit - if you can avoid being exposed.

Whether you pursue science, deception, or something in between, every decision influences your reputation, relationships, and the future of the McCray family business.

A Legacy Left Behind

Following the accident of his father, renowned local Nessie Hunter Willie McCray, Roy McCray returns home to a struggling family business and an investigation that was never completed.

Unable to maintain the once-thriving boat tours and gift shop that supported generations of the family, Roy inherits both the responsibility of keeping the business alive and the unanswered questions that consumed his father's life.

As rumours spread across the Highlands and new sightings emerge, Roy begins his own search for answers. What starts as an effort to save the family livelihood soon becomes a journey into one of the world's greatest unsolved mysteries.

Explore a Living Loch

Loch Ness is yours to discover.

  • Travel across a fully explorable recreation of Loch Ness and the surrounding Highlands

  • Navigate by boat, motorcycle, and on foot

  • Discover caves, islands, villages, and hidden landmarks

  • Explore both surface and underwater environments

  • Experience dynamic weather, changing visibility, and atmospheric conditions

  • Encounter wildlife and a living ecosystem shaped by the environment

Every journey can reveal new clues, opportunities, and discoveries.

Investigate the Unknown

Build your own investigation and decide how to approach the mystery.

  • Track witness reports and historical sightings

  • Identify hotspots and patterns of activity

  • Collect environmental and water samples

  • Deploy sonar systems, hydrophones, drones, and monitoring stations

  • Explore caves, submerged structures, and underwater anomalies

  • Follow leads and develop your own theories

Every sighting is a lead. Every photograph is evidence. Every piece of evidence can change what the world believes.

Photography & Evidence

Photography is more than a feature - it is the heart of the investigation.

  • Capture photographs

  • Develop images in a fully interactive darkroom

  • Analyse evidence for authenticity and quality

  • Build a catalogue of discoveries

  • Publish, sell, or submit findings

  • Earn money and reputation through your work

The world is watching. What will you show them?

Truth or Deception

Not every sighting is genuine.

Choose how far you are willing to go in pursuit of answers, attention, or profit.

  • Create staged sightings and fabricated evidence

  • Manipulate public perception of the legend

  • Generate media attention and tourism interest

  • Earn money from the mystery

  • Risk exposure, damaged credibility, and lasting consequences

Will you uncover the truth, expose the myth, or create your own legend?

Beneath the Surface

Some answers can only be found underwater.

  • Scuba dive into the depths of Loch Ness

  • Explore underwater caves and hidden tunnels

  • Investigate sonar anomalies firsthand

  • Search submerged structures and forgotten locations

  • Manage oxygen supplies and diving risks

  • Discover what lies beneath the loch

The deepest secrets are hidden where few have dared to look.

Key Features

  • First-person and Third-Person open-world exploration

  • Fully traversable Loch Ness and Scottish Highlands

  • Boat navigation, maintenance, and fuel management

  • Motorcycle travel and land exploration

  • Photography, darkroom development, and evidence analysis

  • Sonar, hydrophones, drones, and scientific investigation tools

  • Scuba diving and underwater exploration

  • Dynamic weather and environmental simulation

  • Wildlife and ecosystem interactions

  • Reputation-driven progression systems

  • Hoax creation and deception mechanics

  • Narrative-driven mystery adventure

  • Multiple approaches to investigation and discovery

data.short_description: Investigate the world's most famous mystery in an open-world adventure set on Loch Ness. Explore by boat, investigate sightings, gather and analyse evidence, dive beneath the surface, and uncover long-buried secrets across the legendary loch and Highlands, where not every discovery is what it seems.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Romanian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 8GB / AMD RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, designed for 1080p Low–Medium settings at 30 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1440p High settings with advanced water simulation enabled

content_descriptors.notes:
The Legend of Loch Ness contains mild thematic and atmospheric elements that may not be suitable for all players. The game focuses on exploration, underwater diving, and investigation within a realistic open-world environment.

Players may encounter tense or eerie moments while exploring deep underwater areas and investigating unknown phenomena. There may also be depictions of fictional or implied danger related to mythological creatures and environmental hazards such as drowning risk or deep-sea pressure.

The game does not contain explicit violence, sexual content, drug use, or graphic depictions of harm. Any unsettling content is presented in a non-graphic, atmospheric manner intended to support mystery and exploration rather than horror or shock value.
